title: Family money
subtitle: One inbox. Fewer surprises. Better conversations.
loadError: Unable to load family money. Please try again.
allClear: Nothing needs a decision right now
allClearHelp: Items appear here as your recorded transactions, connections, and valuations need attention.
resolveHelp: Dismissing an item does not edit its transaction or repair its source. Use Review to make those changes.
enabled: Enable family inbox and scheduled checks
disabled: Scheduled checks and delivery are paused. Your saved inbox remains available.
thresholdCurrency: Money thresholds use your profile’s base currency ({{currency}}).
unusualHelp: Unusual charges need at least three earlier charges with the same merchant and currency. Missing conversions do not count as zero.
deliveryHelp: Enabling a channel sends financial summaries to the recipients or endpoint you choose. All channels start off. Settings changes apply to future notifications.
recipients: Family recipients (comma separated, up to five)
emailKey: Resend API key (leave blank to keep)
webhookUrl: Public HTTPS webhook address (leave blank to keep)
webhookToken: Webhook bearer token (optional; leave blank to keep)
credentialsHelp: Credentials and webhook addresses are stored securely and are never shown again. Email can use the web server’s existing Resend configuration.
scheduleHelp: The digest covers the previous calendar month and becomes due at 9 a.m. on the first day, in your profile timezone. The server or desktop app must be running; missed runs catch up.
billsHelp: Add known big expenses so they appear in alerts and next month’s meeting. These reminders do not create transactions.
saveError: Settings could not be saved. Check the delivery configuration and try again.
invalidSettings: Check the highlighted values and bill details.
previewHelp: Choose a month to preview its recorded financial summary. Previewing does not send a message.
savingsHelp: Savings rate is income less consumption, divided by income. It is unavailable when income is zero or data is incomplete.
noBills: No configured bills due next month.
meetingPrompt: Three questions for your money meeting
meetingQuestions: What changed? What needs a decision? What is one action we can take together next month?
retryHelp: A failed or interrupted delivery may already have been received. Check with the recipient before retrying. The next scheduled check processes retries.
deliveryError: Delivery failed or receipt is uncertain. Check the channel configuration and confirm receipt before retrying.
statementReviewDetail: A statement preview is waiting for import. Open the account’s monthly statement panel and select the original files to resume; documents are not stored in the inbox.
statementReminderError: The inbox reminder could not be updated. Your statement import can still proceed.
